s1.syndrome_frame: cutaneous vascular lesion with telangiectasias in a patient with metastatic cancer
salient_findings: single, well-defined, blanchable bright red plaque on the lower right lateral shin
discrete clusters of small-caliber vessels on histopathological analysis
KDR (VEGFR2) c.C2312G, p.T771R somatic mutation identified on genetic analysis
key_facts: patient is a man in his 40s
patient has stage IV KRAS wild-type rectal adenocarcinoma
patient has pulmonary and liver metastases
patient has undergone radiation therapy and multiple chemotherapy cycles
lesion developed in early January 2015
lesion is not associated with pain or pruritus
lesion is 4 cm in diameter
histopathological analysis shows superficial, small lobules of small-caliber vessels
epidermis is normal
genetic analysis was performed using paired whole-exome sequencing of affected tissue and patient's blood

shortlist.label: Bacillary angiomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: matches cutaneous vascular lesion with telangiectasias

shortlist.label: Kaposi's sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: common in immunocompromised patients with cancer

shortlist.label: KDR (VEGFR2) mutation-associated vascular tumor
shortlist.why_kept: patient has KDR (VEGFR2) c.C2312G, p.T771R mutation

shortlist.label: Angiosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: rare but aggressive vascular tumor that can occur in patients with cancer

shortlist.label: Pyogenic granuloma
shortlist.why_kept: can present as a solitary, rapidly growing vascular lesion

raw.rationale: The presence of a KDR (VEGFR2) c.C2312G, p.T771R somatic mutation identified through paired whole-exome sequencing of affected tissue and the patient's blood, along with the histopathological findings of superficial, small lobules of small-caliber vessels, supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Bacillary angiomatosis
rejected.why: Typically associated with Bartonella infection, which is not mentioned in the case

rejected.label: Kaposi's sarcoma
rejected.why: Usually associated with HHV-8 infection and has distinct histopathological features not described here

rejected.label: Angiosarcoma
rejected.why: Typically presents with more aggressive features and atypical cells, not seen in this patient's histopathology

rejected.label: Pyogenic granuloma
rejected.why: Usually presents with a more rapid growth rate and is often associated with trauma or injury, not mentioned in the case
